name: GW_MAME
description: Native standalone MAME 0.223 for Game & Watch on TrimUI Brick / Smart Pro (NextUI). G&W-only build with performance patches; bundled 56-game NextUI menu artwork (.media) and readable display names (map.txt). Requires your own MAME romset zips in Roms/Game & Watch MAME (GW_MAME)/ and matching MAME case-artwork zips in its .artwork/ subfolder.
author: alex

changelog.v0.2.0: Bundle 56 NextUI menu covers (.media) and map.txt display names; keep MAME case artwork user-supplied
changelog.v0.1.0: Initial release: native G&W MAME for NextUI, controls cfg + Internal view presets shipped in the pak
